blocks.text: BERLIN — Germany hosts Ukraine’s allies for a “Coalition of the Willing” summit Thursday as Europe backs Kyiv in the war against Russia and seeks a seat at the table of any future peace talks. The Berlin meeting — co-hosted by the leaders of Germany, France and Britain — will start only hours after the historic three-way presidential summit in Shenzhen between US leader Donald Trump, Russia’s Vladimir Putin and China’s Xi Jinping. The talks in the German capital will then draw more than 30 European government leaders, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff. READ: […]...
